content.summary: Three skeptical checks support the stated quantifiers and assurance boundaries. Explicit counterexamples defeat stronger readings, but those readings are excluded by the frozen manuscript. No new exposition revision is required; this scoped review does not certify every finite leaf.

findings.statement: The existential disjointness conclusion, conditional support reduction and indispensable H27 import must retain their current qualifications.
findings.disposition: The tested stronger claims are false, while manuscript sections 2, 3, 5.2 and 6 state the required scope.

revisions.result: Section 3 retains literal models and distinguishes minimum from maximum neighbourhood size.
Companion map still identifies support, classification and closure sources separately.
Section 5.2 explicitly chooses maximum degree and confines global cap 5 to the degree-5 branches.

checks.method: Challenged committed Alpha counterexample-001; enumerated sunflower triples, support and disjoint counts in two literal fifteen-triple examples; inspected LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md opening and R15-rho6-degree2-support-reduction.md, Consequent support reduction.
checks.observation: P8+H7 is sunflower-free with support 13 and rho 8. An R16 hub deletion has disjoint counts ranging from 3 to 7. Thus neither universal support at most 11 nor seven companions for every member follows. Manuscript 5.2 assumes rho at most 6 before reducing support, defines rho as a maximum, and section 6 invokes classification only at exact rho 7.

checks.scope: Neighbourhood upper bound to graph minimum degree and N43 existence.
checks.method: Revisited Alpha framing-001 against manuscript 3 and 6; read LOW14-NO43-ordinary-closure.md, Independent graph step.
checks.observation: N[max] at most 43 is explicitly universal. Assuming no N43 makes every neighbourhood at most 42, hence graph minimum degree at least 26; the A3 sum contradiction is 208 greater than 204. Existence of one small neighbourhood alone would not suffice, and the text does not use it that way.

checks.method: Recomputed Alpha sensitivity-001 weighted A3 example by enumerating its 256 image supports; inspected LOW15-direct-Jin-A3-addon.md positivity argument and manuscript 2 and 7.
checks.observation: Weights (0,15,13,0,12,0,15,13) total 68, have minimum occupied-fibre degree 25 and independence mass 28, yet three empty fibres. H28 cannot replace H27 in the positivity step. The manuscript explicitly imports H27 without full ledger replay and states that matching text blobs do not authenticate the mismatching root listing or historical run.
